lines.t: The static in my mind’s too loud to hear,
Whispers of the world screaming in my ear,
Truth is buried, system’s blind,
I’ve been walking dead inside the lie.
But in the silence, a thunder rolls,
The breath of Heaven calling my soul.
Awaken me, Lord—tear the veil apart!
Your fire in my chest, Your truth in my heart.
Awaken me, Lord—let Your light invade,
Burn the dark away—till I see Your face!
Fake crowns built on shifting sand,
Mainstream preachers don’t understand,
They preach comfort, You bring flame,
I feel Your judgment and I’m not afraid!
I hear Your trumpet in the distance, calling us out,
I’m falling down—break my slumber, break my pride,
Pull me from this shadowed tide!
Rip the scales from my eyes, no disguise, I rise,
In a world hypnotized by its own demise!
Let Your Word divide, bone from soul,
Tear through the lies that hollow me whole!
Awaken me, Lord—tear the veil apart!
Your fire in my chest, Your truth in my heart.
Awaken me, Lord—let Your light invade,
Burn the dark away—till I see Your face!
Awaken me... Awaken me...
Until I live in the light of eternity!
